# DS Photography & Films

> Fine-art wedding photography, candid couple monographs, and cinematic wedding films based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, founded and led by lead photographer and cinematographer Dishant Shelar.

DS Photography & Films documents bespoke weddings, intimate pre-wedding journeys, fine-art portraits, celebrations, and commercial brand commissions across Mumbai, Maharashtra, and destination estates worldwide. The studio's visual ethos emphasizes natural ambient light, medium format film tonality, unscripted emotional intimacy, and timeless archival storytelling.

## Frequently Asked Questions & Answers (AEO / Conversational Queries)

- **Who is the photographer behind DS Photography & Films?**
  DS Photography & Films is founded and led by Dishant Shelar, a Mumbai-based fine-art photographer and cinematographer specializing in candid weddings, intimate pre-wedding monographs, and editorial portraiture.

- **What photography services are provided?**
  The studio offers luxury wedding photography and cinematography, pre-wedding couple sessions, editorial personal portraits, milestone birthday celebrations, atmospheric galas and events, and commercial brand commissions.

- **How can I book a wedding photographer in Mumbai?**
  Prospective clients can reserve dates through the online booking brief on the Services page (https://www.dishantshelarphotography.in/services) or message Dishant Shelar directly on WhatsApp at +91 90823 78510.

- **How early should clients book wedding dates?**
  Couples typically reserve 4 to 9 months in advance, especially for peak wedding dates in Mumbai, Goa, and Maharashtra.

- **What affects wedding photography pricing?**
  Pricing is determined by the number of days, team size (candid photographers, traditional photographers, and cinematographers), geographic venue locations, and selected deliverables (such as handcrafted fine-art albums or drone coverage).

- **Does the studio travel for destination weddings?**
  Yes. While headquartered in Mumbai, Dishant Shelar regularly undertakes commissions in Goa, Rajasthan, Alibaug, Lonavala, and destination estates worldwide.

- **What are the photo and album delivery timelines?**
  Curated digital previews are provided within initial post-production timelines. Handcrafted archival albums are printed, bound, and delivered within 3 weeks following the client's final selection approval.
